name: Tumbling Portalist
body:
You leap through your portals with such crazy spins and flips that it is much harder for your opponents to strike you.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 3 ranks, create portal class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you exit a portal you gain a +2 dodge bonus until the start of your next turn. If you have 10 or more ranks in Acrobatics, this bonus increases to +4.
